writeup: TIC 412805586 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 7.06 days, identified through automated analysis of TESS photometry. The system shows a primary eclipse with a depth of 8.03 percent dimming, while no secondary eclipse was detected. The eclipse signal carries high statistical significance, with a BLS detection score of 852.3 and pixel-level difference imaging confirming a signal-to-noise ratio of 49.2. However, the alternating eclipse depths show a significant z-score of 34.56, indicating that successive eclipses differ markedly in depth - a pattern consistent with a true orbital period double the initial measurement. This candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a previously uncatalogued object worthy of further study.
